experiment.title: Original Iris Random Forest pipeline
experiment.installCommand: python -m pip install numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.11.4 scikit-learn==1.4.2 joblib==1.3.2 threadpoolctl==3.2.0
experiment.parameters: Original RandomForestClassifier defaults (100 trees), random_state=42; runtime-only pinned dependencies; DVC/pytest/pandas excluded because these two scripts do not use them
experiment.protocol: Original sklearn Iris data; 120 train / 30 held-out test, test_size=0.2, random_state=42. Original evaluator loads the new model.joblib and reconstructs the same split. Educational software case, not a paper benchmark; target below is user-defined.

evaluation.dataset: Built-in sklearn Iris, 150 rows; original 80/20 split, random_state=42; 30 held-out test rows
evaluation.reference: Explicitly user-defined software acceptance target: accuracy 1.0, not a published paper claim or inferred README benchmark
